summary: All 35 active Daniel units were read against the complete local WEB book and the Gen/Exod/Lev corrective-depth bar. Thirty-three seams are defensible when their macro parents and mandatory siblings hydrate retrieval. Dan.8.27 is not a viable independent retrieval object and should merge with Dan.8.15-Dan.8.26. Dan.5.31|Dan.6.1, Dan.11.35|Dan.11.36, and Dan.11.45|Dan.12.1 remain genuine two-option disputes. Famous clauses, dreams, visions, prayers, violent reversals, and numbered disclosures require parent hydration; canonical echoes remain evidence only.

greek_additions_scope_guard.observation: Greek additions associated with Daniel create known length, order, and numbering pressure, especially around the furnace tale and materials placed outside the received Hebrew-Aramaic coordinate sequence.
greek_additions_scope_guard.campaign_action: Do not import any addition, create a pseudo-verse, prefer Old Greek or Theodotion, or infer a canon judgment. Keep every docket inside Dan.1.1-Dan.12.13 and record the outside-coordinate pressure only as evidence.

macro_parents.form: court-entry, test, enablement, examination, and tenure tale
macro_parents.retrieval_rule: Units 1-2 hydrate bidirectionally; food, names, chronology, and court-service queries require the whole parent.

macro_parents.form: dream crisis, petition, revelation, report, interpretation, and reversal tale
macro_parents.retrieval_rule: Units 3-6 remain linked; Dan.2.44 may never surface without the dream report, interpretation, and court frame.

macro_parents.form: image, accusation, refusal, furnace, deliverance, violent decree, and promotion tale
macro_parents.retrieval_rule: Units 7-9 hydrate together; Dan.3.17-Dan.3.18 and the fourth figure never stand alone.

macro_parents.form: royal proclamation enclosing dream, interpretation, realization, restoration, and praise
macro_parents.retrieval_rule: Units 10-13 hydrate together so proclamation, dream, counsel, abasement, and praise interpret one another.

macro_parents.form: feast, desecrated vessels, writing, interpretation, investiture, and fall tale
macro_parents.retrieval_rule: Units 14-16 hydrate together; the Dan.5.31-Dan.6.1 transition also retrieves the opening of unit 17.

macro_parents.form: appointment, conspiracy, prayer, den, deliverance, violent reversal, decree, and prosperity tale
macro_parents.retrieval_rule: Units 17-19 hydrate together; Dan.6.10 and Dan.6.24 require the complete peril-deliverance-decree context.

macro_parents.form: beast vision, heavenly court, human-like figure, interpretation, and closing distress
macro_parents.retrieval_rule: Units 20-22 hydrate together; Dan.7.13-Dan.7.14 is parent-bound and identity-neutral.

macro_parents.form: ram-goat-horn vision, question, interpretation, sealing, and bodily aftermath
macro_parents.retrieval_rule: Units 23-25 hydrate together; merge units 24-25 before finalization.

macro_parents.form: scripture reading, confession-petition, and messenger response
macro_parents.retrieval_rule: Units 26-28 hydrate together; Dan.9.24-Dan.9.27 stays inside the complete answer and forbids date calculation.

macro_parents.form: continuous final revelation: encounter, strengthening, disclosure, culmination, sealing, and riverbank dialogue
macro_parents.retrieval_rule: Units 29-35 hydrate through both chapter seams; no ruler, prince, messenger, event, resurrection system, or schedule is fixed.

ranked_failure_modes.failure_mode: Famous clauses become proof texts detached from their literary parents
ranked_failure_modes.mitigation: Require macro parent, immediate siblings, extraction warning, and identity/chronology/fulfillment neutrality.

ranked_failure_modes.failure_mode: Dream or vision report is orphaned from interpretation, response, or aftermath
ranked_failure_modes.mitigation: Enforce the ten macro parents and bidirectional sibling hydration; merge Dan.8.27 with its interpretation.

ranked_failure_modes.failure_mode: Symbol, ruler, kingdom, prince, messenger, or human-like figure is assigned a single identity
ranked_failure_modes.mitigation: Attach an identity-neutral warning and preserve multiple serious options for external-model and human review.

ranked_failure_modes.failure_mode: Dan.10-Dan.12 is broken into chapter fallback or prediction atoms
ranked_failure_modes.mitigation: Retain Dan.10.1-Dan.12.13 as one mandatory parent and preserve the cross-chapter Dan.10.10-Dan.11.1 unit.

ranked_failure_modes.failure_mode: Seventy weeks, evenings-mornings, time-times-half, 1290, or 1335 becomes a calculated schedule
ranked_failure_modes.mitigation: Keep every number inside its question-answer or vision-interpretation unit; authorize no date, event, fulfillment, or punctuation choice.

ranked_failure_modes.failure_mode: Prayer is extracted as a context-free formula or behavior prescription
ranked_failure_modes.mitigation: Require the precipitating crisis or scripture reading, the complete prayer, and the narrated response.

ranked_failure_modes.failure_mode: Miracle, coercion, or violent reversal is isolated from accusation, peril, deliverance, and decree
ranked_failure_modes.mitigation: Keep the full Dan.3 and Dan.6 parents; flag Dan.3.29 and Dan.6.24 for violence/ethics review without solving them.

ranked_failure_modes.failure_mode: Canonical reuse is promoted into dependence, fulfillment, Christology, eschatology, graph truth, or a boundary
ranked_failure_modes.mitigation: Use only typed evidence-only relation suggestions with explicit non-inferences and no automatic graph or retrieval edge.

ranked_failure_modes.failure_mode: Greek additions or version differences alter the 66-book coordinates or imply a canon decision
ranked_failure_modes.mitigation: Keep additions outside coordinates, select no witness, and record length/order/numbering pressure only.

ranked_failure_modes.failure_mode: The Hebrew-Aramaic switch or lexical roots become source, authorship, date, or meaning authority
ranked_failure_modes.mitigation: Keep Dan.2.4 whole in verse coordinates and use language data only within phrase, clause, discourse, and book context.

ranked_failure_modes.failure_mode: The Dan.5.31-Dan.6.1 transition is forced by one versification or chronology scheme
ranked_failure_modes.mitigation: Keep received coordinates for coverage, record Dan.5.29-Dan.6.3 as a retrieval alternative, and prefer no witness.

ranked_failure_modes.failure_mode: The dense Dan.11 disclosure is converted into a confident historical or modern geopolitical map
ranked_failure_modes.mitigation: Preserve discourse-sized units and the full final-revelation parent; hold identities, chronology, direction, and fulfillment.

relation_recommendations.guard: No decree, anointed figure, covenant, abomination, date, chronology, fulfillment, punctuation, or theology decision.

relation_recommendations.observed_relation: Vision encounter, mediation, conflict, abomination language, crisis, awakening, sealing, and later reuse.
relation_recommendations.retrieval_recommendation: Keep the continuous final revelation parent through both chapter seams before presenting any canonical echo.
relation_recommendations.guard: No messenger, prince, ruler, event, date, resurrection system, eschatology, fulfillment, dependence, or theology decision.

relation_recommendations.observed_relation: Kittim, appointed conflict, awakening, remembrance, and righteous-wicked contrast.
relation_recommendations.retrieval_recommendation: Use only as broader canonical context after the Daniel 10-12 parent is hydrated.
relation_recommendations.guard: No actor or event equation, direction decision, chronology, fulfillment, resurrection system, or eschatological schedule.

must_retain_or_merge_recommendations.reason: The dream report and interpretation answer one impossible demand; Dan.2.44 is unsafe without both.
The accusation, ultimatum, and full answer constrain Dan.3.17-Dan.3.18.
Prayer, surveillance, accusation, and failed royal resistance belong together.
Vision, heavenly court, and interpretation are distinguishable forms but mutually controlling.
The sickness, return to duty, and incomprehension are the interpretation's narrated aftermath, not a viable one-verse retrieval object.
Arrival, commission, and numbered discourse form one answer; Dan.9.24-Dan.9.27 must not be atomized.
The same strengthening and explanatory speech continues through Dan.11.1.
Riverbank questions, oath, refinement contrast, both numbers, and dismissal form one closing dialogue.

no_strong_split_reason: The baseline already follows scene, speech, dream-report, interpretation, prayer-response, and dialogue seams. Further splitting would chiefly create proof-text, identity, chronology, violence, or calculation hazards. The only required structural change is a merge of the one-verse Dan.8.27 coda.

genuine_contested_questions.question: Should the received-coordinate split remain with mandatory Dan.5.29-Dan.6.3 cross-hydration, or should a cross-chapter transition unit be used?

options.case: Keep Dan.5.31 as the feast tale's transition coda and Dan.6.1 as the new appointment setup, but always hydrate Dan.5.29-Dan.6.3.
options.tradeoff: Preserves current coverage and local forms but depends on reliable cross-hydration.

options.case: Use Dan.5.29-Dan.6.3 as a transition object spanning fall, accession, and Daniel's appointment.
options.tradeoff: Handles versification pressure directly but overlaps two otherwise coherent tale parents.

genuine_contested_questions.question: Does Dan.11.36 begin a distinct climactic antagonist movement, or should Dan.11.21-Dan.11.45 remain one antagonist disclosure?

options.case: Treat the renewed king subject, self-exaltation portrait, and final campaign sequence at Dan.11.36 as a new movement.
options.tradeoff: Makes the rhetorical escalation retrievable but can imply an identity or referent change.

options.case: Keep Dan.11.21-Dan.11.45 together because the grammatical subject and appointed-time conflict may continue.
options.tradeoff: Avoids premature identity decisions but produces a dense, long disclosure unit.

genuine_contested_questions.question: Should the current seam be retained with a mandatory Dan.11.36-Dan.12.4 parent, or should the climactic campaign and 'at that time' culmination be one unit?

options.case: End the campaign at the unassisted death in Dan.11.45 and begin the deliverance-awakening-sealing culmination at Dan.12.1.
options.tradeoff: Respects the change in focus but can weaken the explicit 'at that time' dependency.

options.case: Use Dan.11.36-Dan.12.4 as one climactic disclosure movement.
options.tradeoff: Preserves temporal linkage but combines antagonist, deliverance, awakening, and sealing forms.

unit_reviews.baseline_title: Siege setting and court selection of Judean youths
unit_reviews.baseline_form: court-tale exposition and identity reassignment
unit_reviews.boundary_finding: Siege and vessel transfer lead through royal selection, training, named entrants, and imposed names; Daniel's resolve at Dan.1.8 is a genuine counter-action seam.
unit_reviews.proof_text_or_orphan_risk: Dan.1.1-Dan.1.2 can be isolated for chronology or exile harmonization, while names can invite root-fallacy identity claims.

mandatory_parent.reason: Selection, test, enablement, examination, and tenure form one court-entry arc.

explicit_larger_alternative.case_for: Prevents chronology, names, and court intake from floating free of the test and outcome.
explicit_larger_alternative.case_against: The volitional turn at Dan.1.8 supports a precise child.

unit_reviews.baseline_title: Food test, enablement, and successful examination
unit_reviews.baseline_form: test-and-vindication court-tale movement
unit_reviews.boundary_finding: Resolve initiates request, negotiated test, outcome, divine enablement, royal examination, and tenure closure; the internal Dan.1.16-Dan.1.17 shift does not require a detached child.
unit_reviews.proof_text_or_orphan_risk: Food practice can become a diet or guaranteed-wellness prescription if the court test, enablement, examination, and exile setting disappear.

mandatory_parent.reason: The test answers the imposed court formation and reaches the king's examination.

explicit_larger_alternative.case_for: Preserves court intake, counter-action, and result.
explicit_larger_alternative.case_against: Dan.1.8 is a clear action seam and the child is useful with mandatory hydration.

unit_reviews.baseline_title: Impossible royal demand and death decree
unit_reviews.baseline_form: dream-crisis court dialogue and peril escalation
unit_reviews.boundary_finding: Repeated king-wise-men exchanges escalate from demand to universal death decree; Daniel's intervention at Dan.2.14 begins the response.
unit_reviews.proof_text_or_orphan_risk: The intra-verse Hebrew-Aramaic switch at Dan.2.4 can be mistaken for a verse boundary or source/authorship proof, and the violent decree can be detached from its reversal.

mandatory_parent.reason: Crisis, communal petition, revelation, report, interpretation, and reversal depend on one another.

explicit_larger_alternative.case_for: Prevents the impossible demand and execution order from being orphaned from disclosure and reversal.
explicit_larger_alternative.case_against: Daniel's intervention at Dan.2.14 is a strong scene seam.

unit_reviews.baseline_title: Daniel seeks mercy, receives the secret, and blesses God
unit_reviews.baseline_form: intervention, communal petition, night revelation, and hymn
unit_reviews.boundary_finding: Daniel redirects the execution crisis to communal petition; revelation produces a bounded hymn before he returns to Arioch.
unit_reviews.proof_text_or_orphan_risk: The hymn can become an abstract sovereignty formula if crisis, communal prayer, disclosed secret, and court answer are omitted.

mandatory_parent.reason: The petition and hymn answer the death decree and enable the interpretation.

explicit_larger_alternative.case_for: Joins intervention, revelation, thanksgiving, and delivered answer.
explicit_larger_alternative.case_against: The completed hymn and return to Arioch create a genuine form/scene seam.

unit_reviews.baseline_title: Court entry, image dream, and interpretation
unit_reviews.baseline_form: court presentation containing dream report and interpretation
unit_reviews.boundary_finding: Court framing, image report, explicit interpretation formula, kingdom explanation, and certainty close answer the king's single demand.
unit_reviews.proof_text_or_orphan_risk: Dan.2.44 is a high-risk kingdom proof text; metals, stone, mountain, and kingdoms invite fixed chronology, identity, fulfillment, or theology.

mandatory_parent.reason: The dream and interpretation arise from the crisis and lead to the royal response.

explicit_larger_alternative.case_for: Provides peril, revelation, full dream, interpretation, and outcome.
explicit_larger_alternative.case_against: Dan.2.24-Dan.2.45 is a complete court presentation with report plus interpretation.

unit_reviews.baseline_title: Royal acknowledgment, elevation, and appointments
unit_reviews.baseline_form: recognition and status-reversal closure
unit_reviews.boundary_finding: The king's response, confession, Daniel's elevation, and companions' appointments close the peril-to-honor reversal.
unit_reviews.proof_text_or_orphan_risk: Royal worship and confession language can be made a settled theology or ethical endorsement if detached from the court tale.

mandatory_parent.reason: The closure depends on the impossible demand, revelation, and interpretation.

explicit_larger_alternative.case_for: Keeps interpretation and royal outcome adjacent.
explicit_larger_alternative.case_against: Dan.2.46 is a clear response seam and the coda is a complete status reversal.

unit_reviews.baseline_title: Image dedication and universal worship command
unit_reviews.baseline_form: court spectacle, herald decree, and collective compliance
unit_reviews.boundary_finding: Image, gathered officials, herald, repeated instrument register, sanction, and collective compliance establish the test before accusation begins.
unit_reviews.proof_text_or_orphan_risk: The coercive worship decree can be detached from accusation, refusal, deliverance, and the later coercive counter-decree; instrument lists can be atomized.

mandatory_parent.reason: The image command creates the peril resolved by refusal, furnace, deliverance, and decree.

explicit_larger_alternative.case_for: Keeps command, resistance, peril, rescue, violence, and promotion together.
explicit_larger_alternative.case_against: The accusation at Dan.3.8 is a clear narrative seam.

unit_reviews.baseline_title: Accusation, ultimatum, and refusal
unit_reviews.baseline_form: accusation and confrontation dialogue
unit_reviews.boundary_finding: Accusers restate the decree, the king supplies the ultimatum, and the three give one complete answer before execution begins.
unit_reviews.proof_text_or_orphan_risk: Dan.3.17-Dan.3.18 is easily reduced to a slogan about guaranteed rescue or generalized faith while its coercive ultimatum and uncertain outcome disappear.

mandatory_parent.reason: The answer responds to the decree and is tested in the furnace scene.

explicit_larger_alternative.case_for: Keeps accusation, answer, execution, rescue, violent decree, and promotion together.
explicit_larger_alternative.case_against: The changed royal appearance and furnace command at Dan.3.19 begin a new action scene.

unit_reviews.baseline_title: Furnace, deliverance, decree, and promotion
unit_reviews.baseline_form: peril, witnessed deliverance, proclamation, and closure
unit_reviews.boundary_finding: Furnace action runs through witnessed deliverance, inspection, praise, violent decree, and promotion; no internal famous clause should become an unhydrated child.
unit_reviews.proof_text_or_orphan_risk: The fourth figure invites identity claims, miracle mechanics invite apologetic or skeptical resolution, and Dan.3.29's violence can be hidden by extracting only deliverance.

mandatory_parent.reason: The command, accusation, refusal, peril, rescue, coercive decree, and outcome form one tale.

explicit_larger_alternative.case_for: Safest retrieval context for miracle, identity, worship, violence, and ethics.
explicit_larger_alternative.case_against: Dan.3.19 begins a coherent peril-deliverance closure scene.

unit_reviews.baseline_title: Royal proclamation and opening praise
unit_reviews.baseline_form: proclamation superscription and hymnic thesis
unit_reviews.boundary_finding: Formal addressees, peace greeting, declared purpose, and compact praise frame the first-person testimony beginning at Dan.4.4.
unit_reviews.proof_text_or_orphan_risk: Everlasting-kingdom praise can be detached from the dream, abasement, restoration, and closing doxology that explain the proclamation.

mandatory_parent.reason: The proclamation frame interprets the entire dream-realization-restoration account.

explicit_larger_alternative.case_for: Preserves the proclamation as an enclosing document.
explicit_larger_alternative.case_against: Dan.4.4 begins a distinct first-person narrative movement.

unit_reviews.baseline_title: Royal dream of the tree and watcher
unit_reviews.baseline_form: first-person court dream report with embedded decree
unit_reviews.boundary_finding: Tranquility, failed interpreters, Daniel's arrival, tree description, watcher decree, and request form a complete dream report.
unit_reviews.proof_text_or_orphan_risk: Tree, watcher, stump, animal-heart, and seven-times images invite identity, chronology, diagnosis, or angelology claims before the supplied interpretation.

mandatory_parent.reason: Dream, interpretation, realization, restoration, and praise are one proclamation.

explicit_larger_alternative.case_for: Joins the dream directly to its explicit interpretation and counsel.
explicit_larger_alternative.case_against: Daniel's silence and the king's reassurance at Dan.4.19 form a genuine interpretation-dialogue seam.

unit_reviews.baseline_title: Daniel's troubled interpretation and counsel
unit_reviews.baseline_form: interpretation dialogue and admonitory counsel
unit_reviews.boundary_finding: Troubled silence, reassurance, identification, decree explanation, stump qualification, and counsel form one interpretation dialogue.
unit_reviews.proof_text_or_orphan_risk: Dan.4.27 can become a decontextualized moral or political program, while tree and ruler equations can be generalized beyond the local interpretation.

mandatory_parent.reason: Interpretation and counsel are constrained by both the reported dream and narrated realization.

explicit_larger_alternative.case_for: Keeps report, interpretation, realization, and restoration contiguous.
explicit_larger_alternative.case_against: The interpretation dialogue is a complete speech event.

unit_reviews.baseline_title: Fulfillment, abasement, restoration, and praise
unit_reviews.baseline_form: narrated fulfillment and first-person restoration doxology
unit_reviews.boundary_finding: Fulfillment notice, royal boast, heavenly interruption, abasement, restored first-person speech, political restoration, and praise close the proclamation.
unit_reviews.proof_text_or_orphan_risk: Historicity, medical diagnosis, miracle mechanics, empire chronology, and a generalized pride-abasement formula can displace the literary testimony.

mandatory_parent.reason: The opening praise, dream, interpretation, realization, and closing praise form one document.

explicit_larger_alternative.case_for: Safest context for royal voice, dream, chronology, abasement, and restoration.
explicit_larger_alternative.case_against: Dan.4.28 opens a clear realization movement.

unit_reviews.baseline_title: Feast, vessels, handwriting, and failed wise men
unit_reviews.baseline_form: court feast disrupted by an unexplained sign
unit_reviews.boundary_finding: Feast and vessel use lead to praise of material gods, the writing hand, royal terror, reward offer, and failed readers; the queen's entrance resets the scene.
unit_reviews.proof_text_or_orphan_risk: Temple-vessel history, kinship language, handwriting miracle, and divine-agency conclusions can be decided before the indictment and interpretation.

mandatory_parent.reason: Feast, sign, interpreter summons, indictment, interpretation, investiture, and fall form one court tale.

explicit_larger_alternative.case_for: Prevents the feast and unexplained sign from floating free of interpretation and outcome.
explicit_larger_alternative.case_against: The queen's entrance at Dan.5.10 is a strong scene seam.

unit_reviews.baseline_title: Queen identifies Daniel and the king summons him
unit_reviews.baseline_form: advisor speech and interpreter-summons dialogue
unit_reviews.boundary_finding: The queen's advisor speech identifies the needed interpreter; Daniel's entrance and the king's restated crisis and reward prepare his answer at Dan.5.17.
unit_reviews.proof_text_or_orphan_risk: Court titles, kinship claims, spirit-language, and Daniel's identity can be harmonized or theologized without the actual interpretation.

mandatory_parent.reason: The summons exists only to connect the unexplained sign to its indictment and outcome.

explicit_larger_alternative.case_for: Keeps interpreter recommendation, summons, answer, and outcome together.
explicit_larger_alternative.case_against: Daniel's refusal and answer at Dan.5.17 begin a distinct speech movement.

unit_reviews.baseline_title: Indictment, interpretation, investiture, and fall
unit_reviews.baseline_form: court rebuke, sign interpretation, ironic honor, and reversal
unit_reviews.boundary_finding: Gift refusal, comparison with the prior king, indictment, inscription, interpretation, ironic investiture, same-night death, and accession notice close the feast tale in received coordinates.
unit_reviews.proof_text_or_orphan_risk: MENE/TEKEL/PERES wordplay, imperial identities, chronology, kinship, and Darius identification invite overconfident historical or lexical rulings.

mandatory_parent.reason: The sign, summons, indictment, interpretation, and outcome form one tale.

explicit_larger_alternative.case_for: Treats investiture, death, accession, and Daniel's appointment as one cross-chapter transition.
explicit_larger_alternative.case_against: It overlaps the closures/openings of two complete court tales.

unit_reviews.baseline_title: Elevation, conspiracy, and unalterable decree
unit_reviews.baseline_form: appointment, conspiracy, and decree setup
unit_reviews.boundary_finding: Administrative appointment and Daniel's elevation generate investigation, conspiracy, petition, and signed decree; Daniel's response begins at Dan.6.10.
unit_reviews.proof_text_or_orphan_risk: Darius, administrative numbers, unalterable law, and chronology can become historical conclusions; the decree can be detached from prayer and den outcome.

mandatory_parent.reason: The appointment creates the conspiracy and decree resolved by the den and proclamation.

explicit_larger_alternative.case_for: Preserves accession-to-appointment continuity plus the resulting conspiracy.
explicit_larger_alternative.case_against: It merges the prior tale's coda into a new court tale and is too broad for the specific dispute.

unit_reviews.baseline_title: Prayer, accusation, and failed royal rescue
unit_reviews.baseline_form: counter-action, surveillance, accusation, and royal resistance
unit_reviews.boundary_finding: Daniel's informed response is observed and prosecuted; accusers use the unalterable-law claim to close the king's attempted escape before the casting order.
unit_reviews.proof_text_or_orphan_risk: Dan.6.10 can become a universal prayer schedule or architectural prescription if conspiracy, accusation, and den outcome are omitted.

mandatory_parent.reason: Prayer responds to the decree and leads directly to accusation, peril, rescue, violent reversal, and proclamation.

explicit_larger_alternative.case_for: Keeps prayer, prosecution, den, rescue, violence, and decree together.
explicit_larger_alternative.case_against: Dan.6.16 begins a distinct peril-deliverance scene.

unit_reviews.baseline_title: Sealed den, deliverance, judgment, decree, and prosperity
unit_reviews.baseline_form: peril/deliverance with violent reversal and proclamation
unit_reviews.boundary_finding: Casting and sealing lead through royal vigil, morning return, Daniel's report, release, family-inclusive violent counter-judgment, proclamation, and prosperity closure.
unit_reviews.proof_text_or_orphan_risk: Angel and miracle claims, the execution of accusers' families, and the royal decree become distorted if rescue alone is surfaced.

mandatory_parent.reason: The complete tale preserves conspiracy, prayer, peril, rescue, violence, proclamation, and outcome.

explicit_larger_alternative.case_for: Safest context for miracle, innocence, law, violence, and royal theology.
explicit_larger_alternative.case_against: Dan.6.16 clearly begins the den sequence and its closure.

unit_reviews.baseline_title: Four sea beasts and the arrogant little horn
unit_reviews.baseline_form: dated first-person symbolic dream report
unit_reviews.boundary_finding: Dated dream superscription and repeated seeing advance four beasts to the horn focus; throne placement at Dan.7.9 begins the heavenly-court scene.
unit_reviews.proof_text_or_orphan_risk: Beasts, horns, numbers, violence, and ruler sequences invite fixed historical or modern identifications before the supplied interpretation.

mandatory_parent.reason: Vision report, heavenly court, interpretation, and closing distress are mutually constraining.

explicit_larger_alternative.case_for: Keeps beast sequence and heavenly judgment in one vision report.
explicit_larger_alternative.case_against: Thrones at Dan.7.9 create a strong scene/form shift while the chapter parent preserves dependency.

unit_reviews.baseline_title: Heavenly court judges and grants dominion
unit_reviews.baseline_form: heavenly-court vision and dominion grant
unit_reviews.boundary_finding: Thrones, fiery court, opened books, beast judgment, cloud-borne approach, and dominion grant form one heavenly-court scene before Daniel's distress.
unit_reviews.proof_text_or_orphan_risk: Dan.7.13-Dan.7.14 is a premier identity, Christology, fulfillment, and eschatology extraction risk; later canonical reuse cannot decide its boundary or identity.

mandatory_parent.reason: The beast report and angelic interpretation constrain the heavenly-court scene.

explicit_larger_alternative.case_for: Prevents the human-like figure and dominion grant from becoming an identity-proof fragment.
explicit_larger_alternative.case_against: Dan.7.9-Dan.7.14 is a coherent heavenly-court scene useful with enforced hydration.

unit_reviews.baseline_title: Interpretation of beasts, horn, judgment, and kingdom
unit_reviews.baseline_form: angelic interpretation dialogue with closing reaction
unit_reviews.boundary_finding: Distress and inquiry initiate interpretation; a follow-up question expands the fourth beast and horn before judgment, kingdom, and explicit closing reaction.
unit_reviews.proof_text_or_orphan_risk: Kings, saints, times, law, and time-times-half invite fixed identities, chronology, persecution mapping, or doctrinal system construction.

mandatory_parent.reason: The interpretation repeatedly revisits the complete vision report and court scene.

explicit_larger_alternative.case_for: Safest unit for symbol identity, time formula, kingdom, and later reuse.
explicit_larger_alternative.case_against: Dan.7.15 marks a clear interpretation-dialogue and reaction movement.

unit_reviews.baseline_title: Ram, goat, horn, sanctuary crisis, and question
unit_reviews.baseline_form: dated symbolic vision with intravision dialogue
unit_reviews.boundary_finding: Dated/location frame, ram-goat conflict, horn escalation, sanctuary crisis, and holy-ones' question form one vision report; Daniel's attempt to understand begins at Dan.8.15.
unit_reviews.proof_text_or_orphan_risk: Named symbols, continual offering, sanctuary, army/stars, and 2300 evenings-mornings invite identity, chronology, fulfillment, or calculation before the interpretation.

mandatory_parent.reason: Vision, question, interpretation, sealing, and bodily aftermath form one report.

explicit_larger_alternative.case_for: Prevents vision symbols and numbers from floating free of interpretation and aftermath.
explicit_larger_alternative.case_against: Dan.8.15 begins a distinct messenger encounter and interpretive movement.

unit_reviews.baseline_title: Gabriel commissioned to interpret the vision
unit_reviews.baseline_form: messenger encounter and symbolic interpretation
unit_reviews.boundary_finding: Daniel's search for understanding, messenger commission, collapse and touch, named-symbol interpretation, sealing instruction, and Dan.8.27 bodily-vocational aftermath form one interpretive closure.
unit_reviews.proof_text_or_orphan_risk: Named empires and rulers can be overextended into a total chronology; separating the aftermath hides the vision's unresolved bodily and epistemic effect.

mandatory_parent.reason: The interpretation answers the preceding vision and reaches closure only with Dan.8.27.

explicit_larger_alternative.case_for: Includes encounter, interpretation, sealing, sickness, return to duty, and incomprehension.
explicit_larger_alternative.case_against: Dan.8.27 changes from messenger speech to narrated aftermath, but that is an internal coda rather than a standalone unit.

unit_reviews.baseline_title: Sickness, return to duty, and incomprehension
unit_reviews.baseline_form: vision-aftermath closure notice
unit_reviews.boundary_finding: The single verse reports bodily collapse, recovery, return to royal business, wonder, and incomprehension caused by the vision and interpretation; it lacks independent setup.
unit_reviews.proof_text_or_orphan_risk: Standalone retrieval creates an opaque sickness fragment and can encourage medical, psychological, historical, or epistemic speculation without the vision.

mandatory_parent.reason: The aftermath closes the vision-interpretation report.

explicit_larger_alternative.case_for: The aftermath is the interpretation's narrative coda.
explicit_larger_alternative.case_against: The voice/form shifts at Dan.8.27, but not enough to justify an independent retrieval object.

unit_reviews.baseline_title: Daniel reads Jeremiah and turns to prayer
unit_reviews.baseline_form: dated scripture-reading and prayer-orientation frame
unit_reviews.boundary_finding: Dated setting, explicit book-based understanding of Jeremiah's years, and Daniel's prayer posture introduce direct confession at Dan.9.4.
unit_reviews.proof_text_or_orphan_risk: Seventy years can become a chronology calculation, and the explicit Jeremiah relation can be made a fulfillment or harmonization claim apart from the prayer and response.

mandatory_parent.reason: Scripture reading prompts the prayer and the answer arrives while the prayer is still being spoken.

explicit_larger_alternative.case_for: Keeps the scripture-reading frame with the complete prayer it prompts.
explicit_larger_alternative.case_against: Dan.9.4 begins direct prayer and is a clear form seam.

unit_reviews.baseline_title: Confession and petition for Jerusalem
unit_reviews.baseline_form: communal confessional prayer and urgent petition
unit_reviews.boundary_finding: Sustained direct address moves through covenant appeal, corporate confession, prophetic and Torah framing, exodus recollection, Jerusalem petition, and urgent closing imperatives.
unit_reviews.proof_text_or_orphan_risk: The prayer can become a timeless liturgical template, individual guilt formula, political application, or doctrinal proof when its exilic scripture frame and narrated answer are absent.

mandatory_parent.reason: Reading, prayer, and messenger response form one sequence.

explicit_larger_alternative.case_for: Safest context for confession, covenant/Torah language, Jerusalem, and the response.
explicit_larger_alternative.case_against: The direct prayer is a complete embedded form retrievable with mandatory hydration.

unit_reviews.baseline_title: Gabriel arrives and gives the seventy-weeks response
unit_reviews.baseline_form: prayer-response encounter and compressed temporal oracle
unit_reviews.boundary_finding: The repeated 'while I was speaking' binds arrival to prayer; touch, instruction, commission, and the complete numbered discourse run to the chapter close.
unit_reviews.proof_text_or_orphan_risk: Dan.9.24-Dan.9.27 is the highest chronology, punctuation, anointed-figure, covenant, abomination, fulfillment, and theological-system extraction risk in the book.

mandatory_parent.reason: The numbered speech is explicitly a response to the scripture-prompted confession and petition.

explicit_larger_alternative.case_for: Prevents the answer from being detached from the question, prayer, Jerusalem, and Jeremiah frame.
explicit_larger_alternative.case_against: Dan.9.20 begins a complete narrated answer movement.

unit_reviews.baseline_title: Superscription, mourning, river appearance, and collapse
unit_reviews.baseline_form: final-revelation superscription and overwhelming encounter
unit_reviews.boundary_finding: Superscription, three-week mourning, river location, overwhelming appearance, companions' flight, loss of strength, heard voice, and collapse prepare the first touch at Dan.10.10.
unit_reviews.proof_text_or_orphan_risk: Messenger identity, fasting practice, chronology, visionary experience, and canonical likeness echoes can become settled claims before the messenger speech.

mandatory_parent.reason: Encounter, strengthening, disclosure, culmination, sealing, and closing dialogue form one continuous revelation.

explicit_larger_alternative.case_for: Keeps superscription, encounter, touches, explanation, and disclosure frame together.
explicit_larger_alternative.case_against: The hand at Dan.10.10 begins a distinct strengthening dialogue.

unit_reviews.baseline_title: Messenger strengthens Daniel and explains delay
unit_reviews.baseline_form: touch-and-speech dialogue framing final disclosure
unit_reviews.boundary_finding: Repeated touches and assurances restore Daniel; delay, princes, purpose, writing of truth, Michael, and the messenger's prior support remain one speech through Dan.11.1 before 'Now I will show' begins disclosure.
unit_reviews.proof_text_or_orphan_risk: Princes and messengers invite angelic-hierarchy, identity, spiritual-warfare, nation, chronology, or prescription claims; the chapter seam can falsely sever one speaker.

mandatory_parent.reason: The strengthening dialogue frames the continuous disclosure and its closing questions.

explicit_larger_alternative.case_for: Preserves the full encounter and disclosure prologue.
explicit_larger_alternative.case_against: Dan.10.10 begins a distinct touch-and-speech sequence while mandatory parent hydration retains the encounter.

unit_reviews.baseline_title: Successive rulers and north-south conflicts
unit_reviews.baseline_form: compressed dynastic-war disclosure
unit_reviews.boundary_finding: 'Now I will show' opens a compressed succession and north-south conflict sequence through the brief tax-collector successor; the contemptible person's accession at Dan.11.21 is a genuine subject reset.
unit_reviews.proof_text_or_orphan_risk: Dense pronouns, directions, marriage, campaigns, and rulers invite one-to-one historical charts, modern geopolitical mapping, and confident chronology.

mandatory_parent.reason: The disclosure belongs to the encounter, strengthening, climax, sealing, and closing dialogue.

explicit_larger_alternative.case_for: Keeps the dynastic sequence and escalating covenant conflict in one disclosure.
explicit_larger_alternative.case_against: Dan.11.21 introduces a newly characterized subject and sustained antagonist movement.

unit_reviews.baseline_title: Contemptible ruler, covenant conflict, and ordeal of the wise
unit_reviews.baseline_form: disclosure focused on one escalating antagonist
unit_reviews.boundary_finding: A contemptible successor's flatteries, campaigns, covenant hostility, sanctuary profanation, and persecution of the wise run through the appointed-time statement at Dan.11.35.
unit_reviews.proof_text_or_orphan_risk: Ruler, covenant, continual offering, abomination, wise, Kittim, and persecution language invites identity, historical mapping, fulfillment, and present-event application.

mandatory_parent.reason: The disclosure and closing dialogue remain one revelation.

explicit_larger_alternative.case_for: Avoids deciding whether Dan.11.36 changes ruler/referent and preserves one escalating antagonist disclosure.
explicit_larger_alternative.case_against: Dan.11.36's renewed king subject and self-exaltation portrait may mark a distinct climactic movement.

unit_reviews.baseline_title: Self-exalting king's final campaigns and end
unit_reviews.baseline_form: climactic antagonist portrait and campaign sequence
unit_reviews.boundary_finding: Renewed king language, self-exaltation and cult portrait, end-time conflict, territorial sweep, alarm, final encampment, and unassisted end form a plausible climax, but continuity on both sides remains strong.
unit_reviews.proof_text_or_orphan_risk: Dan.11.36 is a high-risk ruler/antichrist proof text; the entire unit invites identity, chronology, modern geopolitical mapping, fulfillment, and violence claims.

mandatory_parent.reason: The climax is framed by the messenger encounter and reaches deliverance, awakening, sealing, and closing questions.

explicit_larger_alternative.case_for: Avoids deciding the Dan.11.36 referent change and preserves the 'at that time' culmination.
explicit_larger_alternative.case_against: It combines antagonist disclosure, final campaign, deliverance, awakening, and sealing into a very large child.

unit_reviews.baseline_title: Trouble, deliverance, awakening, the wise, and sealing
unit_reviews.baseline_form: culmination and sealing instruction
unit_reviews.boundary_finding: 'At that time' links to the preceding campaign, while Michael, unprecedented trouble, written people, awakening, shining wise, and sealing instruction form a culmination before the riverbank scene.
unit_reviews.proof_text_or_orphan_risk: Dan.12.2-Dan.12.3 can be extracted to decide a complete resurrection/afterlife system, Michael's identity, soteriology, eschatology, chronology, or fulfillment.

mandatory_parent.reason: The culmination belongs to the continuous final revelation and its closing dialogue.

explicit_larger_alternative.case_for: Preserves the explicit 'at that time' link from antagonist end to deliverance, awakening, and sealing.
explicit_larger_alternative.case_against: Dan.12.1 changes focus and Dan.12.4 provides a distinct closure.

unit_reviews.baseline_title: River-bank questions, time formulas, and dismissal
unit_reviews.baseline_form: closing vision dialogue and personal commission
unit_reviews.boundary_finding: A new riverbank tableau introduces two others; how-long and outcome questions receive oath, non-understanding, refinement contrast, 1290 and 1335 sayings, repeated dismissal, rest, and final standing assurance.
unit_reviews.proof_text_or_orphan_risk: Every time formula and number invites schedule calculation; speakers, continual offering, abomination, refinement, rest, inheritance, resurrection, and eschatology invite premature decisions.

mandatory_parent.reason: The questions and dismissal close the same revelation begun by the river encounter.

explicit_larger_alternative.case_for: Keeps culmination, sealing, questions, numbers, and dismissal in one chapter close.
explicit_larger_alternative.case_against: The new visual tableau at Dan.12.5 is a genuine scene/dialogue seam.
